annotations.title: Competitive Hiring Report for one job posting

description: Competitive Hiring Report, free summary, for the employer of one US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal, marketing, sales, customer service, admin, operations and logistics, skilled trades, retail and food, or education job posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, bankers, software engineers, data roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, recruiters, marketers) that is not filling: the posted pay range in that market (salary benchmarking) and how many employers are hiring it. The full report, first one free (request_full_report), names each competitor with the pay it posts and how fast it closes the role (posting up to posting down), and shows where this posting sits and how hard the role is to fill there. Measured from employers' own careers sites. Identify the posting by job_url (the careers-site link, or a veritahire.com/j/ link), job_id, or employer + title (+ city, state). A role not yet benchmarked returns status "building" with market_now (the role's market within 25 miles, counted that moment) and retry_after_seconds, the time until the full summary is ready. A posting we do not hold, named by title and city/state, returns status "not_held" with market_now and a link for a report on the role as planned.

job_url.description: The posting's URL on the employer's careers site, or a veritahire.com/j/ URL
